reviewer: Codex assistant; source-backed inspection, not a blinded human review
method: Reviewed every final answer in both repetitions against frozen original source spans and the actual displayed citation excerpts. Recomputed arithmetic; checked conditions, roles, dates, relationships, conflicts and appropriate uncertainty. Keywords were screening only. Facts correct but citations overwritten or clipped can pass correctness while failing citation support. Scope statements describing more sections than their associated citation contains fail citation support.
limits: Model-assisted review can make errors; independently authored and human-reviewed evaluation remains a deployment quality gate.
Synthetic holdout content and generated values were unseen until final evaluation. Its generator templates were known; this is not an independently authored question distribution.
The ambiguous reserved-book question is counted using its frozen pending-reservation interpretation; report alternative sensitivity.
Acceptance questions and keys were frozen, but generic citation-format repairs were informed by earlier acceptance runs. Only final holdout remained unused for implementation changes.
Repeated samples are not independent questions; confidence intervals or perfect accuracy are not claimed.
